title: Conditional voluntary take-over offer for Genting Malaysia Berhad
terms: Cash offer of RM2.35 per GENM share for all 2,870,039,874 GENM shares (50.64% of GENM excluding treasury shares) not already held by GENT. Conditional on GENT and persons acting in concert holding >50% of GENM. First closing date 24 Nov 2025; extended to 1 Dec 2025.
source_title: Conditional voluntary take-over offer for Genting Malaysia Berhad
notes: Became unconditional on 3 Nov 2025 after open-market purchases took GENT's holding above 50%. At close on 1 Dec 2025 GENT held 4,144,966,481 GENM shares = 73.13%. Post-offer purchases raised the stake to 73.798% by 4 Dec 2025 and 73.867% by 2 Apr 2026 (last SSH notice 11371165).

title: Receipt of notice of conditional voluntary take-over offer from Genting Berhad
terms: GENT offered RM2.35 cash per GENM share for all shares not already held.
source_title: Receipt of notice of conditional voluntary take-over offer from Genting Berhad
notes: GENM board appointed an independent adviser; IAC issued 13 Nov 2025 (10694735). Offer closed 1 Dec 2025.

title: Independent Advice Circular on the unconditional voluntary take-over offer
terms: Independent adviser's opinion on the fairness and reasonableness of the RM2.35 offer.
source_title: Independent Advice Circular on the unconditional voluntary take-over offer
notes: Circular PDF stored at data/company_docs/announcements/2025-11-13_10694735_1_Genting_Malaysia_Berhad_IAC.pdf.

title: Genting Berhad raises stake in GENM to 73.798%
terms: Post-offer open-market purchases and take-over acceptances: 24,412,000 shares acquired on 2 Dec 2025, 2,000,000 on 3 Dec 2025 and 11,322,372 shares via take-over acceptance on 3 Dec 2025.
source_title: Genting Berhad raises stake in GENM to 73.798%
notes: SSH notice by GENT. Further purchases took the stake to 73.834% (5 Dec 2025), 73.838% (13 Mar 2026), 73.849% (27 Mar 2026) and 73.867% (2 Apr 2026, announcement 11371165). GENM IAR2025 states GENT owned 73.84% at 16 Mar 2026.

proceeds_use: Part-finance the acquisition of GENM shares under the take-over offer.
source_title: Genting RMTN issues RM900 million MTNs (Tranche 5)
notes: Issued by Genting RMTN, a wholly-owned subsidiary, under the existing MTN Programme.

title: Genting Vista establishes RM5.0 billion unrated MTN programme
terms: RM5.0b nominal unrated MTN programme lodged with the SC under the Lodge and Launch Framework; irrevocably and unconditionally guaranteed by GENT.
source_title: Genting Vista establishes RM5.0 billion unrated MTN programme
notes: Issuer: Genting Vista Berhad, a wholly-owned subsidiary of GENT.

title: Genting Vista issues RM3.0 billion Series 1 MTN
terms: RM3.0b nominal, issued at par, tenure 1 to 5 years, 3-month KLIBOR + 1.80% p.a.
proceeds_use: Redeem the Genting RMTN MTNs used to part-finance the GENM shares acquired under the take-over offer.
source_title: Genting Vista issues RM3.0 billion Series 1 MTN
notes: First issuance under the RM5.0b Genting Vista unrated MTN programme.

title: Genting RMTN MTNs to be redeemed with Genting Vista Series 1 proceeds
terms: The RM3.0b proceeds of the Series 1 MTN are to redeem the Genting RMTN MTNs (tranches 5-8: RM900m + RM495m + RM255m + RM1,350m = RM3.0b).
source_title: Genting RMTN MTNs to be redeemed with Genting Vista Series 1 proceeds
notes: Redemption is the stated use of proceeds; the exact settlement date is not in the announcement.

title: Conditional tender offer for GOHL Capital US$1.5 billion 4.25% notes due 2027
terms: Tender offer by GOHL Capital Limited for its outstanding US$1,500,000,000 4.25% guaranteed notes due 2027; maximum purchase amount set at US$1,250,000,000 on 23 Apr 2026. US$882,462,000 validly tendered and accepted; settlement 4 May 2026; US$617,538,000 remains outstanding.
proceeds_use: Refinancing to extend the GENT group's debt maturity profile.
source_title: Conditional tender offer for GOHL Capital US$1.5 billion 4.25% notes due 2027
notes: Notes listed on HKEX. Results announcement 11568689; settlement 11572519.

title: GOHL Capital Holdings prices US$ subordinated perpetual securities
terms: Subordinated perpetual capital securities, Series 1 perpetual non-call 5.5 (first call 29 Oct 2031) and Series 2 perpetual non-call 10 (first call 29 Apr 2036); fixed rate to first reset, then resets every 5 years; 25bp step-up at year 10.5/10 and further 75bp at year 25.5/30; distributions deferrable and cumulative.
proceeds_use: Repay GOHL Capital Limited's US$1.5b notes due Jan 2027 and other refinancing.
source_title: GOHL Capital Holdings prices US$ subordinated perpetual securities
notes: Issued by GOHL Capital Holdings Limited, guaranteed subordinated by Genting Overseas Holdings Limited, with a subordinated keepwell deed from GENT. Listed on SGX-ST 30 Apr 2026. Principal amount not stated in the Bursa announcement; do not infer.

title: Ratings assigned to the new subordinated perpetual securities
terms: Moody's Investors Service assigned Ba2; Fitch Ratings assigned BB+ to the Series 1 and Series 2 securities.
source_title: Ratings assigned to the new subordinated perpetual securities
notes: Instrument ratings, not corporate ratings.

title: Proposed renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1,250 million
terms: Renounceable rights issue of new GENT ordinary shares on a full-subscription basis to raise gross proceeds of approximately RM1,250m. Issue price and entitlement basis not fixed at announcement; Board intends a 25%-30% discount to TERP based on the 5-day VWAP before the price-fixing date. KHR, KHIL and DILKH irrevocably undertake to subscribe in full for their entitlements (45.10% of shares in issue). Remaining open portion to be underwritten.
proceeds_use: Repayment of borrowings RM800.0m; working capital RM429.5m (interest/financing costs RM280.0m + general working capital RM149.5m); transaction expenses RM20.5m. All within 12 months of listing (expenses 2 months).
source_title: Proposed renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1,250 million
notes: Based on 3,850,576,099 shares in issue excluding 26,320,000 treasury shares at 6 Oct 2026. Expected completion 1Q2027. No subscription price, entitlement ratio or dilution percentage was announced by 2 Nov 2026.

title: Reply to Bursa query on the proposed rights issue
terms: Additional information on the 25%-30% TERP discount and the breakdown of the RM429.5m working-capital allocation.
source_title: Reply to Bursa query on the proposed rights issue
notes: Confirms working capital split: RM280.0m interest/financing costs, RM149.5m general working capital.

title: Listing application submitted for the rights shares
terms: Application for listing and quotation of the rights shares submitted to Bursa Securities.
source_title: Listing application submitted for the rights shares
notes: Still pending as at 2 Nov 2026.

title: RAV Bahamas litigation against Genting Americas Inc.
terms: RAV Bahamas Ltd filed a complaint in the US District Court, Southern District of Florida against Genting Americas Inc. (indirect wholly-owned GENM subsidiary). GAI filed a motion to dismiss on 22 Nov 2024; the court granted dismissal of the complaint in its current form on 1 Jul 2025; RAV filed an amended complaint on 29 Jul 2025; GAI moved to dismiss the amended complaint on 12 Sep 2025.
source_title: RAV Bahamas litigation against Genting Americas Inc.
notes: Updates: 25 Nov 2024 (8510103), 7 Jul 2025 (9926289), 17 Sep 2025 (10372693). No amount claimed or provision disclosed in the announcements.

title: GENM Capital issues RM75 million MTNs
terms: RM75m nominal, issued at par, 1-year tenure, 3.90% p.a. payable semi-annually (Tranche 1 of the sixth issuance under the RM5.0b MTN Programme).
proceeds_use: Operating expenses, capex, investment, refinancing and working capital of GENM group.
source_title: GENM Capital issues RM75 million MTNs

title: Acquisition of remaining 51% of Genting Empire Resorts LLC
terms: Genting ER Limited (indirect wholly-owned GENM subsidiary) acquired the remaining 51% membership interest in GERL from Kien Huat Realty III Limited and accepted assignment of intercompany loans, for total cash consideration of USD41.7 million (including accrued interest).
source_title: Acquisition of remaining 51% of Genting Empire Resorts LLC
notes: Related-party transaction. Completed 31 May 2025 (announcement 9724705).

title: Stipulation for settlement with the Nevada Gaming Control Board (RWLV)
terms: Resorts World Las Vegas LLC and its holding companies signed a Stipulation for Settlement and Order dated 20 March 2025 with the Nevada Gaming Control Board; the Nevada Gaming Commission approved it at its 27 March 2025 hearing. The announcement does not state a monetary penalty.
source_title: Stipulation for settlement with the Nevada Gaming Control Board (RWLV)
notes: Relates to the NGCB complaint dated 15 Aug 2024. Approval announcement 9278925.

title: Handover of Meizhou Wan Phase I power plant (BOT expiry)
terms: SDIC Genting Meizhou Wan Electric Power Company Limited (49%-owned indirect joint venture) handed over its 2 x 393MW Meizhou Wan Phase I coal-fired power plant to Fujian Investment & Development Group at 23:59 on 30 June 2025, on expiry of the 21.5-year build-operate-transfer power purchase agreement.
source_title: Handover of Meizhou Wan Phase I power plant (BOT expiry)
notes: No consideration stated in the announcement.

title: New York commercial casino licence awarded to Genting New York LLC
terms: Genting New York LLC's bid for a downstate New York commercial casino licence was selected by the New York Gaming Facility Location Board on 1 Dec 2025 and awarded by the New York State Gaming Commission on 15 Dec 2025. RWNYC was expected to open the first phase in 2Q2026; full commercial casino operations began on 28 April 2026.
source_title: New York commercial casino licence awarded to Genting New York LLC
notes: Bid submitted 27 Jun 2025 (announcement 9877997); selection 2 Dec 2025 (10730039); award 16 Dec 2025. The bid described a proposed multi-billion-dollar investment but no exact amount was stated.

title: Proposed sale of Empire Resorts' non-gaming assets and related refinancing
terms: Proposal by Empire Resorts Inc. to sell its non-gaming assets (RWC hotel, Alder Hotel, Monster Golf Course, Epicenter and restaurants) to Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corporation for USD525.0m; purchase 1,554.6 acres from EPR Properties for USD201.3m; redeem the USD300m 7.75% senior notes due 1 Nov 2026; and enter into a long-term land lease and management agreement.
source_title: Proposed sale of Empire Resorts' non-gaming assets and related refinancing
notes: On 3 Jul 2026 Empire redeemed the USD300m notes in full and the parties agreed the Proposal would not proceed (announcement 11625481).

title: Empire Resorts redeems USD300 million 7.75% senior notes due 2026
terms: Empire Resorts Inc. redeemed in full the USD300.0m 7.75% senior secured notes due 1 November 2026.
source_title: Empire Resorts redeems USD300 million 7.75% senior notes due 2026
notes: With the redemption, the parties agreed the 15 Aug 2025 asset-sale/refinancing proposal would not proceed.
